meta.name: add-dashboard
meta.description: Add a monitoring dashboard to NanoClaw. Installs @nanoco/nanoclaw-dashboard and a pusher that sends periodic JSON snapshots.

copy.tagline: 添加 NanoClaw 监控仪表板，定期推送数据快照。
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果你管理 NanoClaw 并希望实时观测其状态。
copy.tagline_en: Add a monitoring dashboard to NanoClaw and stream periodic data snapshots.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you manage a NanoClaw instance and want to watch its metrics on a dashboard.

howto.what: Claude 会安装仪表盘相关依赖，复制推送与测试文件，并在启动文件里加上启动代码。之后 NanoClaw 会定时把数据库快照和日志推给本地仪表盘，浏览器即可看到会话、用量、日志等页面。
howto.when: 当你说要给 NanoClaw 添加监控仪表盘/看板，或要求安装 dashboard 组件时触发。

say.text: 给 NanoClaw 加上监控仪表盘
say.note: 技能会安装依赖、复制文件并改动启动代码。

say.text: 给 NanoClaw 加个监控面板，然后再跑一遍验证
say.note: 会构建、跑两个测试，并重启服务做冒烟检查。

say.text: 给 NanoClaw 加个监控面板，端口设成 4100

howto.what_en: Claude installs the dashboard package, copies pusher and test files into src/, and adds a startup block in main(). NanoClaw then pushes DB snapshots and logs periodically to a local dashboard UI.
howto.when_en: Triggered when the user asks to add a monitoring dashboard/panel to NanoClaw or to install the dashboard component.

say_en.text: Add a monitoring dashboard to NanoClaw.
say_en.note: Installs the package, copies files, and edits startup.

say_en.text: Add a monitoring panel to NanoClaw, then run the verification steps.
say_en.note: Builds, runs the two tests, restarts, and checks the service.

say_en.text: Add a monitoring panel to NanoClaw with port 4100.
say_en.note: Sets DASHBOARD_PORT in .env and continues install/verification.
